data.about: The Warsaw Supersam roof carries every load twice: a pair of compression arches spanning wall–column–wall, and one full-span tension cable — proportioned so the horizontal thrusts are equal and opposite. The horizontal components cancel at the walls, the middle strut carries the thrust between the arches, and only vertical forces reach the foundations. Three three-point funicular problems solved over one load line: trial funiculars find the division points, the arch poles sit at H left of the load line, the cable pole at the same H right.
